attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1 via an Ansible playbook run from node2 (control node): created inventorysvc user/group and inventory-readers group, set recursive ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set mode 750 on directories / 640 on files, eliminating all "other" access. Original data (records.csv, config.json) preserved throughout, verified before and after restarting both nodes.
